name: Adaptive Quantile Clipping
tagline: Track the median per-sample gradient norm with a geometric exponential update on the clip threshold, then standard DP-SGD clip+noise around the adaptive C_t.
formula:
$$\text{frac}_t = \tfrac{1}{B}\sum_i \mathbb{1}[\|g_i\|_2 > C_{t-1}],\;\; C_t = \mathrm{clip}\big(C_{t-1}\,e^{\eta_C(\text{frac}_t - q^*)},\; [C_{\min},C_{\max}]\big)$$
$$\tilde{g}_t = \tfrac{1}{B}\sum_i g_i\cdot \min\!\Big(1, \tfrac{C_t}{\|g_i\|_2}\Big) + \mathcal{N}\!\big(0,\,(\sigma C_t/B)^2 I\big)$$
diff_from_baseline: Andrew et al., "Differentially Private Learning with Adaptive Clipping" (NeurIPS 2021). Adapts the L2 clip threshold to a target quantile of observed per-sample norms via a geometric EMA; noise scale is recalibrated each step to the new C_t.

name: AUTO-S Automatic Clipping
tagline: Per-sample normalization g_i / (||g_i|| + gamma): bounds sensitivity to 1 with no clipping threshold, then standard Gaussian noise calibrated to C=1.

key_hyperparams.name: gamma
key_hyperparams.role: denominator stabilizer; trades bias vs scale

diff_from_baseline: Bu et al., "Automatic Clipping: DP Deep Learning Made Easier and Stronger" (NeurIPS 2023). Replaces flat clipping with smooth per-sample normalization, eliminating the clip-threshold hyperparameter while keeping the same privacy guarantee.

name: Standard DP-SGD
tagline: Canonical Abadi-style DP-SGD: flat L2 clip per sample to C and add constant Gaussian noise sigma*C/B to the batch-averaged gradient.
diff_from_baseline: Abadi et al., "Deep Learning with Differential Privacy" (CCS 2016). The reference DP-SGD mechanism: fixed-norm clipping plus calibrated Gaussian noise, with constant sigma over training. Default comparator for this benchmark.

name: Step-Decay Noise + Clip
tagline: Decay both noise multiplier and clip threshold every epochs/4 steps; sigma_0 is rescaled so the harmonic-mean-equivalent sigma matches the calibrated budget.
pseudocode:
1. Schedule: $\Delta = \max(1, E/4)$ epochs per stage; $\rho_\sigma = 0.8$, $\rho_C = 0.85$.
2. Pre-compute $\sigma_0 = \sigma^\star\cdot \sqrt{\sum_e \text{steps}_e/\rho_\sigma^{2k(e)}\;/\;\text{total\_steps}}$ so harmonic-mean sigma equals the budget $\sigma^\star$.
3. At step $(s, e)$: stage $k = (e-1)//\Delta$; $\sigma_t = \sigma_0\rho_\sigma^k$, $C_t = C_0\rho_C^k$.
4. Per-sample clip to $C_t$, batch-average, add $\mathcal{N}(0,(\sigma_t C_t/B)^2)$.
5. Privacy accounting: return $\sigma_{\text{eff}} = \sqrt{s / \sum_{t\le s} 1/\sigma_t^2}$ so the external Abadi accountant sees the correct equivalent sigma.
diff_from_baseline: DP-SGD-Global-Adapt-V2-S (Esipova/Vinzamuri/Pejo et al., ECRA 2025; arXiv:2312.02400). Step-decays noise and clip thresholds together to allocate more privacy budget to later (more useful) steps, while keeping cumulative RDP within the calibrated epsilon via a harmonic-mean-equivalent sigma.
